prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption and redesign changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for sign_in and reorder changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
No clear effect was seen for adoption, redesign, sign_in, or reorder changes, as no test showed a significant win.
Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected results in both tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Quality Preview Screen: Insert a dedicated verification screen after photo upload where users inspect and confirm their custom pet rendering. (why: 3 support emails noted custom pet creation failing or looking wrong, contributing to the 60.9% adoption step dropoff.)
1: [finish, new_flow] Pet Interaction Quickstart Sub-Flow: Add an interactive mascot widget sub-flow on the intro screen to demonstrate desktop pet controls directly. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to pets after setup, and finish conversion is 64.8%.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Path Selection First Sign-In Reorder: Reorder sign-in to occur right after choose_path so account creation locks in user path choices earlier. (why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users; placing authentication right after path selection leverages immediate user intent.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Initialization Status and Tray Hint: Show initialization progress updates and system tray positioning hints while the pet loads. (why: Home target step has a median time of 201s / mean 2336s and 3 support emails reported pet not displaying or app failing to open.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Notification Switch: Enable system desktop notifications so users are alerted the moment pet initialization completes in background. (why: The waiting screen has a very long mean time (2336s), causing users to switch windows and miss pet launch.)
5: [adoption, layout] Split Layout Pet Selection Screen: Switch the pet selection view to a split layout highlighting pet traits and animations side by side. (why: Pick friend is part of adoption where users take a median 89s and mean 1017s to decide.)
6: [finish, copy] Desktop Shortcut Controls Summary: Add clear shortcut key guidance and toggle reminders to the home intro screen. (why: Finish completion is 64.8% and support emails highlighted post-onboarding confusion regarding controlling or hiding the pet.)

scores.note: Adoption has the largest dropoff (39.1%) backed by 3 support emails, but requires a new screen and adoption test history showed minimal lift.
Finish step drops 35.2% and support emails confirm confusion, but building an interactive flow is expensive.
Sign_in loses 27.1% of users, but reorder tests previously yielded no clear win (+0.7%) and lack support email evidence.
Home step has severe latency (mean 2336s) and 3 support emails report pets failing to display; status updates address this clearly.
Low cost notification toggle to pull back users idling during extreme home load times (2336s mean).
Adoption step takes significant time (1017s mean), but support emails target custom quality over layout, and adoption redesign confidence is low.
Finish step drops 35.2% and support emails cite control confusion; copy/guidance change is low cost to implement.
